purpose: Validity repair (differential diagnosis). The parent's decoy NumberUtils.overlay documents that it masks the value but does not, so the parent's misses are defensible. r1 pins both contracts: overlay places the value as given (it must already fit the field) and BitField.widen produces unsigned words. The locally odd line in overlay is unchanged. Survives -> local-oddness/sink blame with a documented gold; recovers -> the parent's effect was gold ambiguity.

edits.old:
*

Overlays a value onto a holder at the position given by its index. The value is * masked to the field so that no bits outside the field can disturb the holder.
edits.new:
*

Overlays a value onto a holder at the position given by its index. Only the field's * position in the holder is cleared; the value is placed as given and must already fit within the field.
edits.why: remove the decoy's doc-code contradiction; pin the decoy's contract

edits.old:
*

Widens the values of a run to {@code long} words.
edits.new:
*

Widens each value of a run to an unsigned {@code long} word holding the value's bits.
edits.why: pin the gold's contract so that the gold owns the defect
